# The logotype, generated by brand/build.py, drawn in the top bar as a vector.
add_embedded_resources(tf_ui_brand "tf_brand.h" "tf::ui::brand"
    "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/brand/logo/tract-form-logotype-on-dark.svg;${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/brand/logo/tract-form-mark-on-dark.svg")

add_library(tf_ui STATIC
    include/tf/ui/editor.h
    include/tf/ui/fake_model.h
    include/tf/ui/model.h
    src/analysis_panel.cpp
    src/controls.h
    src/editor.cpp
    src/fake_model.cpp
    src/graph_panel.cpp
    src/movement_edit.cpp
    src/movement_edit.h
    src/movement_panel.cpp
    src/output_panel.cpp
    src/panel.cpp
    src/panels.h
    src/theme.h
    src/top_bar.cpp
    src/top_bar.h)
target_include_directories(tf_ui PUBLIC include)
target_compile_features(tf_ui PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_link_libraries(tf_ui PUBLIC tf_core hba_visage_ui PRIVATE hba_dsp visage tf_ui_brand tf_warnings)

add_executable(tf-ui-snapshot tools/snapshot.cpp)
hba_build_for_host_only(tf-ui-snapshot)
target_link_libraries(tf-ui-snapshot PRIVATE tf_ui tf_warnings)
